comment: Fun metrics as a player meets them: tools/qa_tour.sh with FRAGR_QA_FUN_METRICS=1 and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/fun-metrics.json. The host's switch under more options, the join page's match line read from /status, and the match feed's notice on join, before the first fight.

states.name: fun_metrics_host_switch
states.note: Run a match with more options open: Fun tally sits below LAN and port, off.

states.name: fun_metrics_join_line
states.note: The join page's match line ends with the tally sentence from /status.

states.name: fun_metrics_feed
states.note: Joined fighter: the match feed says this host keeps a fun tally, upright, before any fight.
